```{r}
#| include: false
snapshot <- readRDS("snapshot.rds")
options(box.path = snapshot$root)
box::use(app / logic / dice[DiceDistribution], app / view / distribution[distribution_table])
result <- DiceDistribution(counts = snapshot$counts)
```

:::
